headline: Motilal Oswal updates stock targets for Mahanagar Gas, PFC, and others after Q2
hook: Motilal Oswal revises targets for Q2 performers
summary: Motilal Oswal has issued revised price targets for several companies including Mahanagar Gas, Power Finance Corporation, and V2 Retail following their Q2 results. The brokerage review assesses the financial health and growth prospects of these firms post-earnings. These updates provide a benchmark for retail investors to compare current market prices against institutional valuations. The report covers a diverse range of sectors from energy to retail and chemicals.
whats_next: Market reaction to the revised brokerage targets in upcoming sessions.
why_it_matters: Institutional target changes often drive short-term stock price action.

headline: Fine Organic Industries issues press release on Q2 and H1 FY27 financial results
hook: Financial results announced for the second quarter
summary: Fine Organic Industries Limited has submitted a press release to the stock exchanges detailing its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The filing provides official data on the company's revenue, profit margins, and operational performance during this period. Retail investors tracking the specialty chemicals sector can review these results to assess the company's growth trajectory and earnings quality.
why_it_matters: Quarterly earnings data guides near-term stock price movement for shareholders.

headline: Motilal Oswal issues Buy ratings on SRF and Atul while giving Sell calls on Deepak Nitrite and Fine Organic
hook: Brokerage picks favorites across 13 chemical names
summary: Domestic brokerage Motilal Oswal has released coverage on 13 specialty chemical stocks, assigning Buy ratings to SRF, Atul, Vinati Organics, and Galaxy Surfactants. Conversely, the brokerage issued Sell calls on Deepak Nitrite and Fine Organic, citing valuation and earnings concerns. Indian retail investors tracking the specialty chemicals sector can use these divergent ratings to reassess their portfolio allocations.
why_it_matters: Reassess chemical holdings based on fresh brokerage calls
winners_losers: SRF and Atul gain / Deepak Nitrite and Fine Organic hurt

headline: Nuvama Wealth recommends Lemon Tree, Greenply, and Fine Organic
hook: Nuvama analyst picks three stocks for today
